answer: Clone firms billed smoke-test clearances for tunnels never entered. A clearance posts only after the inspector ignites a 55-g potassium-chloride candle at grate 16, tracks the 11-minute plume to fan room B, and logs that platform air does not wander more than 0.4 m/s off the sealed 1.7 m/s centerline while river tide stands 1.1–1.9 m, locking 24 POA for 5 epochs. Three detectors must agree within 8 s and a 0.9% opacity band. One key may clear 1 shaft each epoch, so 20 aliases lock 480 POA. A reused candle lot, or two traces sharing 6 of 8 ports, burns 12 POA and bars that key for 4 epochs.
